root_cause.text: The loop increment (`ip++`) in the `for` statement unconditionally advances the 32-bit IPv4 address iterator even after processing the last address, which can cause a retry to start from an unintended position beyond the requested range.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes `ip++` from the `for` loop header and moves it to the end of the loop body, adding a `break` when `ip == ip_to` to prevent incrementing past the upper bound. The CVE description states: "Advancing it once more can move the traversal state past the end of the request, so a later retry may continue from an unintended position."
